statement: At Linux v6.12 hid-wiimote binds Nintendo 057e:0306 or 0330 only when the HID bus is Bluetooth. A per-device unbind/rebind to hid-generic, a driver-binding udev policy, or a machine-wide hid-wiimote module blacklist can prevent kernel write contention but disable the kernel Wii extension/MP evdev interfaces used by xwiimote and evtest on that device. A fixture-only alternate bus or PID can avoid the v6.12 wiimote ID table, but Dolphin must still enumerate/accept the HID path; this can alter other Wii consumers and cannot be promoted as product identity. Dolphin settings can change scanner/real-vs-ControllerInterface selection and whether sound is desired, but do not by themselves disconnect the kernel driver.
